thread_title: S. leucophylla in the wild, Covington Co, AL
breadcrumb: S. leucophylla in the wild, Covington Co, AL

posts.body_html:
What's the beautiful! I have been growing these insectivorous plants in the open air for a long time (see facebook - Zone4b). But I just can't get these white forms ...

We have few of these plants in Russia ...

I received several parcels from France from a friend (I bought), several from a Danish company.

I am very far from politics and therefore I really want the time to come faster when it will be possible to order these plants in your country ...

When I look at these white forms, my heart stops!

Thank you!

And thanks to everyone who protects them, or at least worries about their safety in nature!

Good luck!
